pub struct Ctx;

impl Ctx {
    pub fn get<T>(&self) -> Option<T> { None }
    fn via_turbofish<T>(&self) -> T { loop {} }
    fn never_called<T>(&self) -> T { loop {} }
}

pub struct Config {
    #[serde(default = "default_port")]
    port: u16,
}

fn default_port() -> u16 { 8080 }
fn unused_default() -> u16 { 1 }

#[pymodule]
fn native() { let _x = 1; }

#[panic_handler]
fn on_panic() { let _x = 2; }

#[cortex_m_rt::entry]
fn start() { let _x = 3; }

#[wasm_bindgen_test]
fn web_case() { let _x = 4; }

#[pyclass]
struct Handle;

fn main() {
    let c = Ctx;
    let a = c.get::<u8>();
    let n = c.via_turbofish::<u8>();
    let g: Option<Config> = None;
}
